sloka: लोकनाथस्य रामस्य सखा दासोऽस्मि राक्षस ।न मया मोक्यसे.द्य त्वं पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तेजसा ।। ६-४०-१०।।
transliteration: lokanāthasya rāmasya sakhā dāso'smi rākṣasa ।na mayā mokyase.dya tvaṁ pārthivendrasya tejasā ।। 6-40-10।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! I am a friend and servant of the king of kings, ruler of the world. By his power I will not leave you!", Sugriva said.
